name: ueventtrack
description: U-EventTrack: Laravel API backend and React frontend for Hostinger deployment

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend && cp -r frontend/dist build && cd backend && composer install --optimize-autoloader --no-dev --no-scripts && php artisan package:discover --ansi
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cd backend && php artisan serve"
